summary_en: This phase I/II study tests sapanisertib added to cabozantinib in hepatocellular carcinoma (liver cancer) that has spread and has a change in the β-catenin gene. Both drugs are taken by mouth: sapanisertib is taken 3 days on and 4 days off per week, 5 days on and 2 days off per week, or on days 1-28 of each 28-day cycle, and cabozantinib is taken daily on days 1-28 of each cycle, repeated while the disease does not progress and side effects are acceptable. The primary outcome is not stated; the study is Phase I/II and looks at side effects, the best dose, and how well the treatment works.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase I/II prueba sapanisertib añadido a cabozantinib en carcinoma hepatocelular (cáncer de hígado) que se ha diseminado y tiene un cambio en el gen de la β-catenina. Ambos medicamentos se toman por vía oral: sapanisertib se toma 3 días con tratamiento y 4 sin tratamiento por semana, 5 días con tratamiento y 2 sin tratamiento por semana, o los días 1 al 28 de cada ciclo de 28 días, y cabozantinib se toma a diario los días 1 al 28 de cada ciclo, repitiéndose mientras la enfermedad no progrese y los efectos secundarios sean aceptables. El resultado principal no está indicado; el estudio es de fase I/II y observa los efectos secundarios, la dosis más adecuada y qué tan bien funciona el tratamiento.
who_for: Liver cancer confirmed by lab testing that cannot be treated with a cure-intended approach
β-catenin mutation found by next generation sequencing (Phase 2 portion)
Prior systemic therapy for metastatic disease, including a prior immune checkpoint inhibitor unless not eligible
Age 18 or older, ECOG performance status 2 or better, and Child-Pugh score A
not_for: Side effects from prior cancer treatment that are above grade 1, except hair loss
Use of strong CYP3A4-inhibiting medicines, or inability to swallow oral medicines
